basic_details.job_title: IOCL Western Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 335 Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentice Posts
basic_details.job_location: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Goa, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli
basic_details.application_mode: Online only, via NAPS (Apprenticeship India) or NATS portal

age_limit.age_details: 12-month Apprenticeship Training under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973/1992 (as amended)

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: 3-year regular full-time Diploma in the respective Engineering discipline, min. 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD, reserved positions), from a recognized Institute/University
Matriculation with a regular full-time 2-year ITI course in the respective trade, recognized by NCVT/SCVT
Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA, etc.), min. 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD, reserved positions), from a recognized Institute/University
Class 12th (below graduate), min. 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD, reserved positions)

Class 12th (below graduate) plus a 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' Skill Certificate (training under 1 year) from a body recognized under the National Skill Qualifications Framework or the Central Government

qualification.details: All qualifications must be through a regular full-time course; Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning qualifications render a candidate NOT ELIGIBLE CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade must be converted to an equivalent percentage as per the Board/University/Institute's own norms, and the conversion certificate must be produced at document verification Diploma students admitted via lateral entry (Class XII Science/ITI admitted directly to 2nd year) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed marks based on all semesters A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings in total, and the second must be in a different trade, with at least a 1-year gap between the two (no gap required if the earlier training ended due to employer default) Candidates holding or pursuing a higher qualification (B.E./B.Tech, MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB, or equivalent), completed on or before joining, are NOT ELIGIBLE Candidates must apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one leads to summary rejection of all applications

salary_details.details: The rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, and the Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025, as amended from time to time. Not specified in the official notification: the exact per-month stipend figure for each apprentice category.

selection_process: There is no written test or interview. Candidates who successfully register and apply on NAPS/NATS against a notified opportunity are considered A merit list is prepared for each post based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification and must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test; candidates should review IOCL's "Guidelines and Criteria for Physical Fitness for Pre-Engagement Medical Examination" (available at iocl.com/apprenticeships) before applying Shortlisted candidates whose documents and medical fitness certificate are found in order are issued an Offer of Engagement Unfilled opportunities after initial shortlisting are filled from the remaining panel/merit list for the same opportunity SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats are considered only if they meet the General-category standard
how_to_apply: Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Technician (Diploma) Apprentice and Graduate Apprentice: Register at nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php.

Log in to the respective portal using your User ID/e-mail ID and apply against the opportunity listed under "Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Marketing Division) – Western Region" (NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053; NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332).
Ensure your profile is 100% complete (personal, educational, category details) before submitting; apply for ANY ONE discipline code only.
Submit the application by 04 November 2026, 5:00 PM – apply well in advance of the deadline.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details (State-wise & Category-wise)
content_sections.text: 99 Technician Apprentice 40 Trade Apprentice (ITI) 174 Graduate Apprentice 22 Data Entry Operator Note: *PwBD figures are a horizontal subset within the Total/UR/EWS/SC/ST/OBC counts for Graduate Apprentice and Data Entry Operator only – not an additional number. PwBD candidates are NOT eligible for Discipline Codes 101–111 (all Technician and Trade/ITI disciplines); they may apply only for Graduate Apprentice (Code 112) and Data Entry Operator (Codes 113/114), and only within the PwBD sub-categories PV (Low Vision/Blind), PH (Hard of Hearing/Deaf), PL (Musculoskeletal/Locomotor, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victim, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured), or MD (Multiple Disabilities) – other disability types are excluded given the hazardous nature of the industry. Seats are tentative and may increase/decrease at management's discretion.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written test or interview . Candidates who successfully register and apply on NAPS/NATS against a notified opportunity are considered A merit list is prepared for each post based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification and must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test; candidates should review IOCL's "Guidelines and Criteria for Physical Fitness for Pre-Engagement Medical Examination" (available at iocl.com/apprenticeships) before applying Shortlisted candidates whose documents and medical fitness certificate are found in order are issued an Offer of Engagement Unfilled opportunities after initial shortlisting are filled from the remaining panel/merit list for the same opportunity SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats are considered only if they meet the General-category standard

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27
content_sections.text: Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Technician (Diploma) Apprentice and Graduate Apprentice: Register at nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php . Log in to the respective portal using your User ID/e-mail ID and apply against the opportunity listed under "Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Marketing Division) – Western Region" (NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053 ; NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332 ). Ensure your profile is 100% complete (personal, educational, category details) before submitting; apply for ANY ONE discipline code only. Submit the application by 04 November 2026, 5:00 PM – apply well in advance of the deadline. Important: Applicants must apply only against vacancies notified under the Western Region states/UTs listed above; selecting a training location outside these states in the portal will result in rejection. No corrections are entertained after final submission – contact the NAPS/NATS office directly for any correction needed before applying.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (At Document Verification)
content_sections.text: 10th std/SSLC/Matriculation certificate/mark sheet (sole accepted proof of date of birth) Latest caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), in the prescribed Government proforma, from a competent authority For OBC-NCL: a caste certificate not more than 12 months old (from 30.09.2026) explicitly excluding creamy-layer status, per DoPT OM dated 08.09.1993; the OBC caste must fall in the Central List for the respective state Regular-mode and year-of-passing certificate from the Institute Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma Final ITI/HSC/Graduation/Diploma certificate Copy of first page of Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and a cancelled cheque leaf Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate Disability certificate per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, for PwBD candidates All documents must be furnished in original along with a self-attested copy.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidate must have an active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year; all future communications (document verification/offer letter) are sent by e-mail only Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of certificates; engagement is liable to cancellation/termination at any stage if ineligibility, false information, or suppressed facts are detected, even after joining Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange or Vocational Rehabilitation Center for PwBD must apply through the NAPS/NATS portal; otherwise their candidature will not be considered Mere completion of document verification/empanelment does not confer any right of engagement as an apprentice On completion of the apprenticeship, IOCL has no obligation to offer employment, nor can an apprentice claim employment on the ground of having completed the training Canvassing in any form disqualifies a candidate Any corrigendum/addendum will be published only on iocl.com/apprenticeships The Management's decision on eligibility, selection mode, and cancellation of the process (in part or full) is final and binding, with no correspondence entertained

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice vacancies has IOCL notified in Western Region?
faq.answer: 335 vacancies across Technician (99), Trade/ITI (40), Graduate (174), and Data Entry Operator (22) apprentice categories, spread over 7 states/UTs.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. Which portal do I use?
faq.answer: Technician (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice candidates use the NATS portal; Trade (ITI) and Data Entry Operator candidates use the NAPS/Apprenticeship India portal.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: No. Selection is purely merit-based on percentage of marks in the qualifying examination, followed by document verification and a medical fitness test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 24 years as on 30 September 2026, with relaxation for OBC-NCL, SC/ST and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Can PwBD candidates apply for all disciplines?
faq.answer: No, PwBD candidates are not eligible for Technician or Trade/ITI disciplines (Codes 101-111); they may apply only for Graduate Apprentice and Data Entry Operator posts.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one discipline code?
faq.answer: No, applying for more than one discipline code leads to summary rejection of all your applications.

faq.question: Q8. Does this apprenticeship guarantee a job at IOCL?
faq.answer: No. IOCL has no obligation to offer employment on completion of the apprenticeship training.
